paper_name: A Stochastic Framework for Multiprocessor Soft Real-Time Scheduling
paper_description: Generalizes GEDF tardiness bounds to stochastic execution times, deriving expected tardiness bounds without utilization loss when expected utilization < m, implying bounded quantiles of tardiness distribution.

formal_description.statement: Sporadic task tau_i with period P_i, relative deadline D_i = P_i, execution time random variable X_i with E[X_i] = e_i, utilization U_i = e_i / P_i.
formal_description.conclusion: Models probabilistic execution for soft RT

informal_sketch.intuition: Replaces WCET with mean for provisioning.
informal_sketch.pseudocode:
class StochasticTask:
    def __init__(self, i, P, dist_e):
        self.i = i
        self.P = P
        self.e = np.mean(dist_e)  # expected
        self.U = self.e / self.P
